publicationGroups.name: Serious violence, abuse and detention
publicationGroups.question: Separate existing bounded matches from missing mayhem, torture, child/elder harm, domestic injury, aggravated kidnapping, hostage and trafficking branches; verify injury, actor and age conditions with sentencing dependencies.

publicationGroups.name: Sexual-offense branch expansion
publicationGroups.question: Read shared age, force, incapacity, custody, registration and exploitation provisions once; publish exact branches rather than one generic label for a whole statute. Do not infer penalty or registration consequence from an instruction title.

publicationGroups.name: Threats, hate crimes and stalking
publicationGroups.question: Keep substantive conduct separate from motive enhancements; review order/prior-dependent stalking punishment and any missing threat branches.

publicationGroups.name: Weapons conduct and explosive devices
publicationGroups.question: Separate carrying, possession, discharge, brandishing, prohibited-person predicates, storage and explosive conduct. Compare current source changes and enforceability before publication; PEN 30515 remains held. CALCRIM 2500 is a template requiring weapon-specific research, not one charge; 2561 retains separate-count review.
